title: PuTTYNG needs update (security)
author: opbod
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead): PuTTYNG.exe seems based on a PuTTY 0.83 version from Sept 2025, per the commit ID 9cb330cf4d7b2f3aa7c5fdcbb3ca64dad3dded44 found in PuTTYNG.exe -> About.
Meanwhile 0.85 is available containing various (non-critical) security fixes: https://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/~sgtatham/putty/changes.html.


**Steps to reproduce:**

1. Open PuTTYNG.exe -> About
2. Verify commit ID

**Version** (Help → About, or the nightly filename):
1.83.0

**Environment**...
notes: PuTTYNG 0.85 shipped aeea728c7 (pipeline fixes in fork c26baf07); lab-verified 5/6 + A/B; awaiting reporter About-box confirm on nightly
